size.note: Newman's 30–34 cm. Wikipedia 28–36 cm. Wingspan: Wikipedia gives 63 cm. Mass: Newman's Birds gives 90–240 g.

habitat: Open woodland, tree savanna and Acacia-dominated riparian bush (Newman's; SABAP1).

distribution.note: GBIF records per 10 000 bird records in each region: far north 11, north 13, central 14, south 8.6 (counted 13 November 2026). Recorded most often in the central region, and nearly as often in the north.

summary: A small goshawk with grey throat and breast, deep red eyes, finely barred belly, and a conspicuous white rump in flight. Melanistic morph (about 6–14% in southern Africa per SABAP1) is all-dark with the white rump still often visible (Newman's; SABAP1).

similar.note: Shikra has rufous banding to the throat and lacks Gabar's white rump (Newman's).
Little Sparrowhawk is smaller with yellow (not red) eyes and white spots on the uppertail (Newman's).
Dark Chanting is much larger and greyer without Accipiter shape (Newman's).

research.note: No seasonal plumage change is described in the sources consulted, except presence/absence of migrants. Gaps: No juvenile/immature image in selected set. No flight image in selected set. Structured marks keep the common form. The melanistic form is not a separate variant. Melanistic form ~6–14% of southern African individuals (SABAP1); white rump often still visible (Newman's; SABAP1). The schema has no morph field. Colour phrases outside the vocabulary were stored as the nearest swatch: deep red to red; orange-red to orange and red.
